title: Fix missing button colors in documentation site
body:
Button components in the documentation were rendering without colors. The site layout wasn't importing `@object-ui/components/style.css`, which defines the CSS custom properties (`--primary`, `--destructive`, etc.) that Tailwind classes depend on.

## Changes

- Added `import '@object-ui/components/style.css'` to `apps/site/app/layout.tsx`

```diff
 import { RootProvider } from 'fumadocs-ui/provider/next';
 import './global.css';
+import '@object-ui/components/style.css';
 import '@object-ui/plugin-aggrid/style.css';
```

## Result

All button variants now render with proper colors:

![Button colors restored](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/31be7e9a-7729-4aec-b7bf-9c7b7869a78c)
